core: C selected AND at least 2 distinct ML-verified genes
auxiliary: C selected AND gene-rescue selected AND stability Monte Carlo lower bound > 0.5 AND at least 1 ML-verified gene
review: (B selected OR C selected OR at least 3 ML-verified genes) AND NOT merged
evaluation_status: Retrospective development after inspecting earlier results on these 100 mixtures; new fusion rule fixed before its evaluation. No independent validation.
statistical_interpretation: ML match scores and selection stability are evidence diagnostics, not calibrated family-presence probabilities. Evidence channels share the same trees.
